card.architecture: Nomos2 HQ (DAT2, fixed 4x) - a feed-forward super-resolution transformer, no diffusion
card.summary: Upscale photographic and real-world images through Nomos2's high-quality DAT2 network. One deterministic pass: it resolves existing texture, grain and edge detail and hallucinates nothing, so faces, text and fine structure stay honest to the source. The network is fixed at 4x; Scale below 4 fits the 4x result down to the size you asked for.
use_cases: enlarge a photograph while keeping skin, fabric and foliage texture
resolve a photographic render without a diffusion pass reinterpreting it
finish an image whose content is already correct and only needs resolution
card.nsfw_capable: yes - no content model, it only resolves pixels
card.commercial_use: yes - Nomos2 HQ DAT2 is CC-BY-4.0 (attribution required)
card.pick_when: The source is photographic or photoreal. Use Anime for drawn art; the photo net will chew on flat colour and clean line work.

prompt.guidance: This editor takes no prompt. Anything typed in the instruction box is ignored - there is no text encoder in the graph.
prompt.instructions: Send a source image and set Scale. No prompt, no seed, no steps: the same source always produces the same output. Scale 4 is the network's native factor and its sharpest result; lower values downscale that 4x output to fit.
do: Feed it a photographic / photoreal source
Use Scale 4 when you want the network's full native detail
dont: Expect invented detail - it resolves what is there, it does not restore what is missing

negative.note: Feed-forward SR network; there is no conditioning of any kind.

speed.note: A single transformer pass. No sampling loop, but DAT2 is heavier than the anime CNN (~140 MB of weights); ComfyUI tiles it to fit.
speed.measured_note: Not yet benchmarked on this box.

ui_help.note: Send an image and pick a Scale. No prompt is used. Output is deterministic - re-running gives the identical image.
ui_help.good_for: enlarging photographs while keeping texture honest

edit_use_cases: upscale a photographic image, preserving the composition exactly
